name: media-modal-default

frames.best_why: Frame 3 shows the red media panel expanded large over the grid; frames 1-2 show only the two small tiles.

tagline: Two media tiles; click one to blow it up over the other.
summary: A two-up grid of media panels, one still image and one video, that each expand to a large view when clicked. The pair sits edge to edge in its container.
appearance: Two rounded media panels side by side: a deep red scene with a glossy red disc-like object, and a blue scene with a green sponge-like object. One panel can grow to fill most of the frame while the other peeks out behind.
behaviour: Clicking a panel grows it to a large single view while the other slides behind; clicking it again returns the pair. The right panel plays a looping video.
demo_content: A red glossy 3D disc render and a green 3D sponge video on blue
search_phrases: click media to view it full size
two videos side by side that expand
media grid that opens full screen
popup video that fills the screen
use_when: A pair of images or clips should preview small but be readable full size.
avoid_when: The demo hardcodes two remote media URLs and gives no captions or controls.
customise: The two media URLs are written in the file; swapping the image, the video or the pair needs a source edit.
weight_why: Two remote media panels with a streaming video and a layout animation.

a11y.note: Panels are click targets with no labels or keyboard handling, and the media carries no captions.

issues: No captions or labels identify the two media items.
The enlarged panel leaves uneven black margins around the media.
polish_why: Bold glossy media and a clean two-up grid; unlabeled panels and uneven expanded framing reduce it.
title: Media Modal Default
